predThresh = input(0.6, "Predictable Threshold", 0.3, 0.9, 0.05)

prevC = close[1]
trA = high - low

trC = abs(low - prevC)
tr = max(trA, max(trB, trC))
atrVal = atr(high, low, close, atrLen)
atrHigh = highest(atrVal, coilLen)
coilLoad = 1 - (atrVal / max(atrHigh, 0.000001))
barRange = high - low
rangeHigh = highest(barRange, coilLen)
rangeCoil = 1 - (barRange / max(rangeHigh, 0.000001))
combined = (coilLoad + rangeCoil) / 2
rangeNorm = barRange / max(rangeHigh, 0.000001)
vovMean = sma(atrVal, vovLen)
vovSd = stdev(atrVal, vovLen)
vov = vovSd / max(vovMean, 0.000001)
vovRising = vov > vov[1]
chg = close - close[1]
absChg = abs(chg)
meanChg = sma(chg, predLen)
meanAbsChg = sma(absChg, predLen)
predictability = abs(meanChg) / max(meanAbsChg, 0.000001)
rangeLow = lowest(barRange, coilLen)
releaseRange = barRange > relMult * rangeLow
buyState = combined > coilThresh and vovRising and releaseRange and close > open
sellState = combined > coilThresh and vovRising and releaseRange and close < open
buySig = buyState and not buyState[1]
sellSig = sellState and not sellState[1]
loadedCross = combined > coilThresh and combined[1] <= coilThresh

predLoadedSig = predLoadedState and not predLoadedState[1]

candidateLow = htfLow[swingLb]

winLow = lowest(htfLow, swingLb * 2 + 1)

isSwingLow = candidateLow <= winLow and candidateLow > 0

if isSwingLow {

bullHold := htfClose > lastSwingHigh and lastSwingHigh > 0 ? bullHold[1] + 1 : 0
bearHold := htfClose < lastSwingLow and lastSwingLow > 0 ? bearHold[1] + 1 : 0

bearConfirmEdge = bearConfirmed and not bearConfirmed[1]

oppIntactShort = lastSwingHigh > 0 and htfHigh < lastSwingHigh ? 30 : 0

closeBotShort = closePos <= 0.25 ? 30 : 0

shortConf = compShort1 + oppIntactShort + closeBotShort
